fixes: Rewrite “It comes with a removable shoulder strap and an internal zipped pocket—two details you may want to look over as you decide whether it is right for you.” to include the bag's current price and one practical detail such as dimensions or capacity.

Cut “There is no need to make that decision from this email. Your basket gives you a direct route back to the purchase you began, where you can continue if you choose.” because the CTA already makes that clear.

Cut “If the bag is still on your mind, you can take another look and decide in your own time. Nothing more is being asked here.” because it repeats the reminder without adding decision-relevant information.
